# v2026.10.42

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.42.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.42.md).

This release covers **2 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- An invoice rule can now say "Pending, with a note": a draft that matches goes to the Pending tab, and its invoice page shows what to fix. ([#216](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/216))
- A rule can read the invoice Reference, so a Reference with a stray number or a placeholder name is held for a person. ([#216](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/216))
- Practitioner rules can check a list (is one of, is not one of), picked from the practitioners already on jobs. ([#216](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/216))
- New text tests: contains, starts with, has a number and is one word, for a bare first name or a trailing case number. ([#216](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/216))
- Send works as a gate: each press runs every check again, a draft that fails stays on Pending, and the rest go. ([#216](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/216))

## Changes

- Invoice rules: new Then "Pending, with a note", a Reference field, and list and text tests for Practitioner and Reference. ([#216](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/216))
- Send on ticked invoices sends the ones that pass and counts the ones held; Approve refuses a draft that fails a pending rule. ([#216](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/216))

## Fixes

- An invoice edited just before Send can no longer go out while it fails a check. ([#216](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/216))
